name: Radio
summary: One choice from a small set (2 to 6) of options that are all visible. Always in a group.
use: Options that exclude each other and that the user must compare.
reactProps: Use the same name within a group.
behaviour: Arrow keys move within the group. Tab goes to the next group.
a11y: Native radios in a <fieldset> with a <legend>.
content: Short labels of the same kind. Use the hint for what happens ("Pay a fixed amount every month.").
do: Select a safe default option if there is one.
dont: A single radio without a group.
